title: Highlights a specified notification
goal: Use the ID selector to set a unique color for one notification in a group.
summary: selector starts with # followed by the id value of the element. Each id value within a page should be unique.
tasks: Use the ID selector to select the closure notification with the id of closure.
Set the text of this notification to #754619 and the background to #fff5da. Keep the original style of the opening hours notice.
hint: Both notifications use the notice class. Use # to add the id of the target notification to limit the changes to this one.

example.note: In the self-lading bill, if you mark the unique pickup time with id="pickup-time", you can press this ID to bold the time line.
